description: This file defines the ConduitContext class, which extends Entity Framework's DbContext to manage database interactions for the Conduit application. It includes DbSet properties for domain entities such as Articles, Comments, Persons, and Tags, configures entity relationships in OnModelCreating, and provides transaction handling methods.

classes.name: ConduitContext
classes.description: Entity Framework database context for the Conduit application, managing entity sets and transaction handling.

methods.name: BeginTransaction
methods.description: Starts a new database transaction if none is active and the database is not in-memory.

methods.name: CommitTransaction
methods.description: Commits the current transaction, with exception handling to rollback if committing fails.

methods.name: RollbackTransaction
methods.description: Rolls back and disposes of the current transaction.
